description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for editing radio button input elements, including setup, content management, and event handling.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Handles the dialog display event, initializes the radio button element if selected.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the dialog confirmation, creates or updates the radio input element.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Prepares dialog content based on the selected element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Commits the dialog input values back to the element.
